_readme: Reference repo config (written by `foreman onboard`, edited by hand or via the factoryd config endpoint). models.default applies to every stage until overridden; stage keys: plan, implement, review. fallback entries are 'provider/model[:thinking]' strings tried in order on provider errors (timeouts are NOT retried on another model — a hung stream is a host problem). required_checks: names of GitHub checks that must pass; ["*"] (the onboard default) requires every check the PR reports and stays inert when the repo has no CI; [] disables the CI gate. Also editable at runtime: POST /repos/<slug>/config. scenario.ports are RESERVED across all repos (the onboard planner widens the window and skips live listeners + docker publishes); runtime/holdout are file names relative to this directory. skip_labels: issues with any of these labels are never claimed (the factory's own factory:needs-info gate label is always skipped). origin_url: override the clone URL (private repos with a token, or test fixtures). env: 'host' runs stages as plain processes; 'compose' runs every stage as root inside the product's own docker-compose worker service (compose_file is resolved in the worktree) or in the fallback `image` with pip/uv/npm cache volumes until the repo ships a compose file — installs inside are ordinary work; the host stays clean; scenario runs are the only publishers of the reserved port pair (publishPorts is scoped to them), agent stages exercise their server container-locally. 'instabox' runs implement+review inside a disposable InstaBox microVM (https://instabox.sh) booted from env.instabox.snapshot (built once with `foreman bake <slug>`; falls back to `template` until baked); the plan stage stays host-side, scenario servers run in the machine and probes reach them through ssh-forwarded 127.0.0.1 ports. pass_env forwards host env vars into the container/machine when present (model keys, GITHUB_TOKEN). env.instabox.snapshot: the TOKEN 'shared-base' (recommended) resolves VPS-side via state/base-snapshot.json to the current fleet base — never hardcode a versioned name; a literal snapshot name is for repos with their own fork.
